engine.win_condition: Control the game with efficient counterspells, using Baral's cost reduction and card-draw trigger to maintain resources. Generate infinite colorless mana and storm count via Hullbreaker Horror loops to close out the game.

Deploy high-toughness creatures (including defenders) and use Felothar to enable them to attack and deal damage equal to their toughness. Generate card advantage by sacrificing creatures to Felothar to draw cards equal to their toughness. Win through overwhelming toughness-based combat damage.

Deal combat damage with creatures to trigger Gonti's ability and other saboteur effects, exiling cards from opponents' libraries and casting them at reduced cost to generate overwhelming card advantage.

Win through Underworld Breach loops generating infinite storm with Lion's Eye Diamond and Brain Freeze for mill, or instantly via Thassa's Oracle after Demonic Consultation or Tainted Pact exile the library. Kess enables graveyard recursion to assemble and protect the combo.

Leverage K'rrik's life-for-mana ability to fuel multiple combo lines: Bolas's Citadel + Sensei's Top + Aetherflux Reservoir for storm damage, Gray Merchant + Chainer loops for infinite drain, or Peer into the Abyss + Sheoldred to kill opponents through forced draw.

Chain enchantments for card advantage via Tuvasa's draw trigger and other enchantress effects, then win through Tuvasa commander damage (growing +1/+1 per enchantment) or overwhelming board presence from enchantment payoffs.

Generate infinite mana via Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter, Power Artifact + Basalt/Grim Monolith, or Emry loops with Mirran Spy, then win through Urza's activated ability to cast the deck or close with Oracle/alternate win conditions.
Deal direct damage through Ozai's firebending ability, burn spells, and damage multipliers. The Aggravated Assault combo provides an alternate infinite combat line, but burn is the primary plan.
Cast noncreature spells to enable commander combat triggers, then win through combat damage via Human Torch's omnivore ability and The Thing's counter accumulation.

Sacrifice and recur lands from graveyard via Szarel to repeatedly trigger landfall payoffs, drawing cards through The Gitrog Monster and growing creatures with Szarel's counter ability, then winning through combat damage or overwhelming value advantage.

Force opponents to attack each other using Nelly Borca's goad and suspect abilities, draw cards when opponents' creatures deal combat damage to other opponents, and win through attrition and incremental damage while opponents weaken each other.

Give opponents card draw via Ms. Bumbleflower's cast triggers and group-hug effects while accumulating +1/+1 counters on creatures. Win through combat damage with an increasingly large board that outgrows the resources given to opponents.

Give opponents control of permanents using Zedruu's activated ability, generating life gain and card draw from Zedruu's upkeep trigger. Win through accumulated card advantage and damage effects while protected by pillowfort defenses.
